_doc: Revert-verify mutants for issue #4370 — a canonical [[uid]] reference to an asset whose exo__Asset_label is prefix__Local is emitted as that label's term IRI; CommandResolver now maps it back to the file subject (resolveRefIriSubject). One mutant per resolution site, the helper (M9 = main before #4370) and its ambiguity guard (M10). Z0 (premise) and H1/H2 (human-labelled controls) stay green under every mutant. `red_re` anchors on the `● <suite> › [Xn]` failure header.
subject: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO YOUR exocortex CHECKOUT>/packages/core/src/services/CommandResolver.ts

M1_style_ref_raw._note: loadLinkedStyle takes the IRI reference as the subject again.

M2_precondition_ref_raw._note: resolvePreconditionRef returns the IRI reference as-is: a symbolic precondition vanishes and the command shows UNGATED.

M3_query_ref_raw._note: loadPreconditionQueryRef reads Asset_uid off the IRI reference itself.

M4_grounding_ref_raw._note: resolveGroundingRef returns the IRI reference as-is: the grounding does not load and loadCommand returns null. U1 (twice-mounted grounding) and W1 (warning count, via the ambiguous grounding) also route through resolveGroundingRef: with it raw, U1 stays unresolved and W1 sees 0 warnings.

M5_step_ref_raw._note: loadCompositeSteps takes the IRI step reference as the subject again.

M6_ref_triple_object_raw._note: resolveRefTripleObject (property defaults, inheritance rules) returns the IRI as-is.

M7_linked_uid_raw._note: getLinkedUID reads Asset_uid off the IRI itself, then falls back to the path basename (`exocmd#SymCommand`).

M8_linked_uids_raw._note: getLinkedUIDs (CommandBinding_overrides) reads Asset_uid off the IRI itself.

M9_helper_identity._note: resolveRefIriSubject returns every IRI unchanged — equivalent to main before #4370 at all eight sites. Type-preserving form (a bare `if (ref)` narrows ref to never below and breaks compilation — integration-test-revert-verify §A36).

M10_ambiguity_guard_removed._note: Two assets sharing one prefix__Local label: without the guard the reference resolves to whichever bearer was indexed first (edit-history order) — the command runs another asset's grounding instead of staying unloaded as on main. W1 turns red too: without the guard no warning is emitted at all.

M11_warn_dedupe_removed._note: The ambiguous-label warning is emitted on every call: in the plugin `warn` is a user-facing toast, so one ambiguous label would toast on every render and after every save (#3186 precedent, _fallbackWarnedKeys). Type-preserving condition.
